short_bio: Actress, author, and social media star Tabitha Brown became a beacon of vegan comfort food after a 30-day plant-based challenge helped her manage chronic pain. Her approachable, soul-warming recipes prove that vegan eating can be deeply satisfying and joyful.

base_diet.name: Vegan Comfort Food Kitchen
base_diet.description: A whole-food vegan approach rooted in comfort and soul. Tempeh, jackfruit, and black beans stand in for meat while generous portions of greens, grains, and avocado make every plate satisfying and nourishing.
base_diet.philosophy: Brown adopted a plant-based diet after a 30-day vegan challenge dramatically eased the chronic pain she had struggled with for years. She believes vegan food should feel like a hug — comforting, flavorful, and accessible to everyone, not just seasoned health enthusiasts. Her approach centers whole, minimally processed plants prepared with generous seasoning and Southern-inspired technique.

recipes.title: TTLA Sandwich
recipes.description: Tabitha's signature tempeh bacon, tomato, romaine, and avocado sandwich on whole wheat bread — hearty, smoky, and completely plant-based.

instructions.text: Slice tempeh into thin strips. Whisk together tamari, smoked paprika, maple syrup, and a pinch of garlic powder in a shallow bowl. Marinate tempeh strips for 5 minutes.
Heat avocado oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook tempeh strips 3 to 4 minutes per side until caramelized and crispy.
Toast the whole wheat bread slices. Mash half the avocado with a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of sea salt, then spread onto the toast.
Layer tempeh strips, tomato slices, and romaine lettuce leaves onto the avocado toast. Close the sandwich and serve immediately.

recipes.tips: Press the tempeh for 15 minutes before marinating for extra-crispy strips. The sandwich is best assembled just before serving so the bread stays crisp.

recipes.title: Pulled Jackfruit Tacos
recipes.description: Smoky pulled jackfruit seasoned with cumin, smoked paprika, and black pepper, piled into corn tortillas with avocado and fresh cilantro.

instructions.text: Drain jackfruit and pull apart with your hands or two forks to create a shredded texture. Pat dry with paper towels.
Heat avocado oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add diced yellow onion and cook until softened, about 4 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook 1 more minute.

Add jackfruit to the skillet along with cumin, smoked paprika, black pepper, and sea salt. Stir well to coat. Cook over medium-high heat, pressing jackfruit with a spatula to encourage browning, for about 10 minutes until edges are caramelized.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side. Fill with jackfruit, sliced avocado, and fresh cilantro. Squeeze lime juice over each taco.

ingredients.preparation: drained and shredded (young green in brine)

recipes.tips: Use young green jackfruit packed in brine or water, not syrup. The longer you cook it while pressing, the more the shreds mimic pulled pork texture.

recipes.title: Creamy Vegan Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: Whole wheat pasta smothered in a golden, cashew-and-vegan-cheese sauce boosted with nutritional yeast for a rich, comforting mac that satisfies without compromise.

instructions.text: Soak raw cashews in hot water for 10 minutes, then drain. Cook whole wheat pasta according to package directions until al dente. Reserve 0.5 cup pasta water before draining.

Blend soaked cashews with oat milk, nutritional yeast, garlic powder, onion powder, turmeric, sea salt, and black pepper until completely smooth. Add 2 to 3 tablespoons pasta water to reach a creamy, pourable consistency.
Pour cashew cream into a saucepan over medium-low heat. Add shredded vegan cheese and stir until melted and smooth, about 3 minutes.
Toss drained pasta with the cheese sauce until evenly coated. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve immediately, garnished with an extra pinch of smoked paprika.

ingredients.preparation: soaked in hot water 10 min then drained

recipes.tips: Turmeric gives the sauce its golden hue without adding much flavor. Do not over-blend the cashew cream — stop once it is silky smooth to avoid it becoming too thick.

recipes.title: Carrot Sticks and Hummus
recipes.description: Crisp carrot sticks served alongside creamy hummus — Tabitha's go-to simple snack that keeps energy steady between meals.

instructions.text: Peel carrots and cut into evenly sized sticks, about 3 inches long and 0.5 inch wide.
Spoon hummus into a small bowl. Arrange carrot sticks alongside and serve.

recipes.tips: Refrigerate cut carrot sticks in cold water up to 3 days — they stay crunchier than storing them dry.

recipes.title: Brown Rice, Black Bean, and Greens Bowl
recipes.description: A nourishing grain bowl of fluffy brown rice and seasoned black beans over a bed of fresh spinach, finished with sliced avocado and a squeeze of lime — simple soul food that fuels the whole day.

instructions.text: In a saucepan over medium heat, warm avocado oil. Add diced yellow onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute more.

Add drained black beans to the pan along with vegetable broth, cumin, smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper. Simmer uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes until the liquid reduces and beans are lightly saucy.
Divide fresh spinach between two bowls. Spoon warm black beans over the spinach — the heat will gently wilt the greens.
Add a generous scoop of cooked brown rice to each bowl. Top with sliced avocado and squeeze lime juice over everything. Garnish with fresh cilantro.

recipes.tips: Batch-cook brown rice ahead of time and refrigerate for up to 4 days — it reheats beautifully with a splash of vegetable broth.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats with Banana and Chia
recipes.description: Creamy overnight oats layered with chia seeds, sliced banana, and a drizzle of maple syrup — a no-cook breakfast Tabitha reaches for when mornings are busy but nourishment still matters.

instructions.text: Combine rolled oats, chia seeds, oat milk, maple syrup, cinnamon, and vanilla extract in a jar or container. Stir well to combine.
Cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least 6 hours until the oats have absorbed the liquid and thickened.
In the morning, stir the oats and add a splash more oat milk if desired for a thinner consistency. Top with sliced banana and hemp seeds before serving.

recipes.tips: Prepare two or three jars at once on Sunday night for grab-and-go breakfasts through midweek. The oats keep in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Hemp Seeds
recipes.description: Mashed avocado on toasted whole wheat bread topped with sliced tomato and a generous sprinkle of hemp seeds.

instructions.text: Toast two slices of whole wheat bread until golden and crisp.
Halve the avocado, scoop the flesh into a bowl, and mash with a fork until mostly smooth with some texture. Season with sea salt and black pepper.
Spread mashed avocado evenly over each toast slice. Layer sliced tomato on top.
Finish with a generous sprinkle of hemp seeds over each toast. Serve immediately.

recipes.tips: Press the avocado mash into the toast immediately after toasting so it clings without sliding. Use ripe avocados that yield to gentle pressure for the smoothest spread.

recipes.title: Savory Tempeh Scramble on Toast
recipes.description: Crumbled tempeh pan-cooked with mushrooms and tomato, served over toasted whole wheat bread for a Southern-inspired vegan breakfast.

instructions.text: Crumble the tempeh into small irregular pieces using your hands or a fork. Slice mushrooms into thin pieces.
Heat avocado oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add crumbled tempeh and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes until golden on the edges.
Add sliced mushrooms to the pan, season with smoked paprika, garlic powder, sea salt, and black pepper. Cook for 4 minutes until mushrooms are tender and the mixture is fragrant.
Stir in diced tomato and cook for 1 minute just to warm through. Toast the bread and serve the scramble on top.

recipes.tips: For extra-crispy tempeh, press the block between towels for 10 minutes before crumbling. Add a splash of tamari in the last minute for a deeper savory note.

recipes.title: Loaded Avocado and Mushroom Wrap
recipes.description: Sauteed mushrooms and mashed avocado rolled inside a whole wheat tortilla with sliced tomato and a sprinkle of hemp seeds.

instructions.text: Heat avocado oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add sliced mushrooms, season with sea salt and black pepper, and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until tender and lightly golden.
While the mushrooms cook, halve the avocado, remove the pit, and mash the flesh with a fork. Season lightly with sea salt.
Warm each whole wheat tortilla in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side until pliable.
Spread mashed avocado across the center of each tortilla. Top with cooked mushrooms and sliced tomato, sprinkle hemp seeds inside, then roll tightly and slice in half.

recipes.tips: Do not overfill the wrap or it will be hard to roll tightly. Spread the avocado all the way to the edges so every bite has coverage.

recipes.title: Jackfruit and Avocado Wrap
recipes.description: Pan-caramelized shredded jackfruit tucked into a whole wheat tortilla with mashed avocado, romaine lettuce, and sliced tomato.

instructions.text: Drain the jackfruit and shred into fibrous pieces using two forks. Pat dry with paper towels.

Heat avocado oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add jackfruit, cumin, smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper. Cook over medium-high heat, pressing with a spatula, for 8 to 10 minutes until edges are caramelized.
Warm each whole wheat tortilla in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side. Spread mashed avocado across the center of each.
Layer romaine lettuce leaves, sliced tomato, and caramelized jackfruit onto each tortilla. Roll tightly and slice in half to serve.

ingredients.preparation: drained and shredded (young green in brine)

recipes.tips: Use young green jackfruit packed in brine or water, not syrup. The longer you press and cook the jackfruit, the better the caramelized edges develop.

recipes.title: Tempeh, Mushroom, and Avocado Sandwich
recipes.description: Crispy pan-fried tempeh strips and sauteed mushrooms stacked on toasted whole wheat bread with mashed avocado, romaine, and tomato.

instructions.text: Slice tempeh into thin strips. Whisk tamari, smoked paprika, and a pinch of garlic powder in a shallow bowl. Marinate tempeh strips for 5 minutes.

Heat avocado oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook tempeh strips 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and crispy. Remove and set aside. In the same pan, add sliced mushrooms with a pinch of sea salt and cook 4 to 5 minutes until browned.
Toast the whole wheat bread slices. Mash avocado with a squeeze of lemon juice and sea salt, then spread generously onto each toast.
Layer tempeh strips, sauteed mushrooms, romaine lettuce, and tomato slices onto two of the toast slices. Close the sandwiches and serve immediately.

recipes.tips: Press the tempeh for 10 minutes before marinating for crispier strips. Assemble just before eating so the bread stays crunchy.

recipes.title: Carrot and Avocado Salad Wrap
recipes.description: Ribbon-cut carrots tossed with diced avocado and romaine, wrapped in a whole wheat tortilla and finished with hemp seeds.

instructions.text: Peel the carrots and use a vegetable peeler or box grater to cut them into thin ribbons or shreds. Place in a bowl.
Dice the avocado and add to the carrot bowl. Add a squeeze of lemon juice, sea salt, and black pepper, and toss gently to combine.
Warm each whole wheat tortilla in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side. Lay romaine lettuce leaves across the center of each.
Spoon the carrot-avocado mixture over the romaine. Sprinkle hemp seeds over the top, roll each tortilla tightly, and slice in half to serve.

recipes.tips: Toss the carrot ribbons with lemon juice right before rolling to keep them vibrant and prevent browning. A pinch of cumin in the avocado mixture adds a subtle earthy note.

recipes.title: Pasta with Mushroom and Vegan Cheese Sauce
recipes.description: Whole wheat pasta tossed with sauteed mushrooms and diced tomato folded into a rich, glossy melted vegan cheese sauce.

instructions.text: Cook whole wheat pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package directions until al dente. Reserve 0.5 cup pasta water before draining.

While pasta cooks, heat avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, for 6 to 7 minutes until golden brown. Season with garlic powder, sea salt, and black pepper.

Add diced tomato to the mushrooms and stir for 1 minute. Add shredded vegan cheese and 3 to 4 tablespoons of reserved pasta water. Stir over medium-low heat until the cheese melts into a glossy sauce.
Add drained pasta to the skillet and toss well to coat every strand. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve immediately, garnished with nutritional yeast if desired.

recipes.tips: The reserved pasta water is key — its starch helps the vegan cheese bind into a smooth sauce. Add it a tablespoon at a time until the consistency coats the back of a spoon.

recipes.title: Jackfruit Stuffed Whole Wheat Wraps
recipes.description: Seasoned pulled jackfruit with melted vegan cheese inside warm whole wheat tortillas, loaded with romaine, tomato, and avocado.

instructions.text: Drain jackfruit and shred with two forks. Pat dry with paper towels. Heat avocado oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.

Add jackfruit along with cumin, smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper. Cook over medium-high heat, pressing jackfruit flat with a spatula, for 10 to 12 minutes until edges are deeply caramelized.
Warm whole wheat tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side. Scatter shredded vegan cheese over each warm tortilla and let it melt from the heat of the tortilla for 1 minute.
Layer jackfruit, romaine lettuce, sliced tomato, and sliced avocado onto each tortilla. Fold burrito-style by tucking in the sides and rolling tightly. Slice in half and serve.

ingredients.preparation: drained and shredded (young green in brine)

recipes.tips: Warm the tortilla just before adding the cheese so it melts from residual heat. Place the wrap seam-side down while you assemble the others to keep it closed.

recipes.title: Tempeh and Mushroom Pasta Bake
recipes.description: Whole wheat pasta tossed with browned crumbled tempeh, mushrooms, and tomato, then baked under a layer of melted vegan cheese until bubbling.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit. Cook whole wheat pasta in salted boiling water until 2 minutes short of al dente. Drain and set aside.

Heat avocado oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add crumbled tempeh and cook for 5 minutes until browned. Add sliced mushrooms and cook 4 more minutes until golden. Season with garlic powder, smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper.
Stir in chopped tomato and cook for 2 minutes. Add drained pasta and toss everything together until well combined. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Spread the pasta mixture evenly in a baking dish if not already oven-safe. Top evenly with shredded vegan cheese. Bake for 15 minutes until the cheese is melted and the edges are bubbling.

recipes.tips: Slightly undercooking the pasta before baking prevents it from becoming mushy. Let the bake rest for 5 minutes out of the oven before serving so the cheese sets slightly.

recipes.title: Avocado and Hemp Seed Smash on Bread
recipes.description: Half an avocado mashed onto a slice of toasted whole wheat bread, topped with thin tomato slices and a sprinkle of hemp seeds.

instructions.text: Toast one slice of whole wheat bread until golden and firm.
Scoop half the avocado into a small bowl and mash with a fork until smooth. Season with sea salt and black pepper.
Spread the mashed avocado onto the toast. Lay thin tomato slices on top and finish with a tablespoon of hemp seeds.

recipes.tips: Wrap the unused avocado half tightly in plastic wrap with the pit still in place and refrigerate — it will stay fresh for up to a day.

recipes.title: Tempeh Bites with Carrot Sticks
recipes.description: Bite-sized cubes of tempeh pan-fried until golden and crispy, served alongside fresh raw carrot sticks.

instructions.text: Cut tempeh into 0.75-inch cubes. In a small bowl, whisk tamari and smoked paprika together. Toss tempeh cubes in the marinade.
Heat avocado oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add tempeh cubes in a single layer and cook for 4 to 5 minutes per side until all faces are deep golden and crispy.
While tempeh cooks, peel the carrots and cut into sticks about 3 inches long. Arrange on a plate alongside the finished tempeh bites.

recipes.tips: Resist the urge to move the tempeh bites while they cook — letting them sit undisturbed on each side is what creates the crisp exterior. Pat the cubes dry before marinating for best results.

recipes.title: Vegan Cheese and Tomato Open-Face Toast
recipes.description: A slice of toasted whole wheat bread topped with melted vegan cheese, fresh tomato slices, and a sprinkle of hemp seeds.

instructions.text: Toast a slice of whole wheat bread until golden. Transfer to a baking sheet lined with foil.

Spread a generous layer of shredded vegan cheese over the toast. Place under a broiler on high for 2 to 3 minutes until the cheese is melted and beginning to bubble at the edges. Watch closely to avoid burning.
Remove from the broiler and immediately top with sliced tomato and a sprinkle of hemp seeds. Serve warm.

recipes.tips: Keep the toast on the top rack under the broiler and do not leave unattended — vegan cheese can go from melted to scorched in under a minute. Add the fresh tomato only after the broiler step so it stays bright.
